title: Sandtrapped | KEY.co
description_expanded: Upon stepping inside, visitors are greeted by a haven of sophistication and comfort, where every detail is meticulously crafted for an exquisite living experience. The home unfolds over three levels of opulence, from a king-sized master bedroom with an ensuiting lavish bathroom on the first floor to a sumptuous top-level retreat featuring a game and living room that opens onto a stunning deck. The outdoor kitchen, modern fireplace, and expansive sliding doors leading to the pool area merge seamlessly to create an atmosphere of light and airiness, perfect for gatherings or serene moments alone. On the second level, balconies with captivating pool views accompany each king-sized bedroom, offering a daily spectacle of beauty. The property's design, marked by warm Luxury Vinyl Plank flooring and high-end finishes, sets the stage for an array of memorable moments, whether starting the day with coffee overlooking the expansive yard or winding down in luxurious linen sheets. Sandtrapped is not just a place to stay; it's a doorway to a lifestyle of luxury, relaxation, and adventure, encapsulating the very essence of coastal living at its finest.
